justification: Murray's tagged Out, that ain't a projection, that's a doctor's note, so Bo Nix walks in under center and nobody says a word about it being a demotion — the kid's healthy and he's up, end of story. Chase Brown put the ball on the carpet in a game we lost last week, and that's the code, no exceptions, no matter how good the matchup looks — he sits his one week, we don't discuss it after this. Kamara steps into that RB2 chair, he's shown me he plays through pain before and the number's better than what's left on my bench anyway. Javonte keeps his spot, Coleman keeps the flex, Washington and Cooper keep the receiver jobs, LaPorta's still my tight end, and Bates and the Seattle D ride as-is — everybody else earned their seat at the table Sunday morning and nobody's losing it over one bad week.
